title: Universal Battery Tester Checker for C, AA, AAA, D, N, 9V & 1.5V Button Cell Compact Mini Battery Checker

items.h: Supports C, AA, AAA, D, N, 9V & Button Cells
Clear Analog Display for Quick Readings

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Stay powered and efficient with the Universal Battery Tester Checker—your go-to solution for instantly checking the charge level of almost any household battery. Whether it's AA batteries in your remote, 9V in a smoke detector, or button cells in a watch, this compact tester gives you fast and accurate results without needing any external power.


The analog display clearly shows whether the battery is Good, Low, or Replace, helping you reduce battery waste and save money. Perfect for homes, workshops, offices, and travel kits, this mini battery checker is lightweight, durable, and incredibly easy to use.


Specifications:

  • Product Type: Universal Battery Tester / Checker
  • Compatibility: Cylindrical Batteries: AA, AAA, C, D, N9V Block Batteries
  • Button Cells: 1.5V types such as LR44, AG13, CR2032, SR44, etc.
  • Display Type: Analog (Needle Indicator)
  • Power Source: Not required (uses battery being tested)
  • Material: High-quality ABS plastic
  • Color: Black with red slider
  • Dimensions: Approx. 11 cm × 4 cm × 2.5 cm
  • Weight: ~35g
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C to 40°C
  • Made For: Home, office, workshop, electronics repair, travel
